bullets: Own a defined product area, feature set, or workflow within FinSuite Platform and drive it from discovery through launch and post-launch iteration.
Write product requirements, user stories, success metrics, rollout plans, and launch-readiness materials that engineering and design can execute against.
Drive day-to-day squad execution, including sprint participation, prioritization, risk identification, and cross-team dependency management.
Build and maintain a quarterly roadmap for the owned area, with a biannual view of priorities and sequencing, in partnership with more senior PMs.
Define and track metrics for the owned workstream, covering adoption, reliability, operational efficiency, revenue enablement, and AI or self-service coverage where applicable.
